rule_1.text: Rewrite the instruction as a short, plain imperative that keeps the same objects and goal.

samples.task: put pan on stove from sink
samples.base: place the pan on the blue burner
samples.rewrite: Place the pan on the blue burner.

samples.base: set the orange cup on the plate
samples.rewrite: set the orange cup on the plate

samples.task: put fork from basket to tray
samples.base: move the fork from the basket to the tray
samples.rewrite: Move the fork from the basket to the tray.

samples.base: set the orange cup onto the plate
samples.rewrite: set the orange cup onto the plate
